propositions: Replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer that records minimal authoritative JSON to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock, using three-attempt CAS with 100ms and 200ms retry backoff

Implement identical read-only status command accessible via canonical 'rebar bridge status' and hidden alias 'rebar bridge-status' with precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY > NEVER_RUN and corresponding exit codes

Derive stable local identity as local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id for last-pass writer and status, treating missing/empty/unreadable values as hard configuration error, while preserving LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID and inbound event metadata unchanged

Canary moves from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable git state by fetching refs/reconciler/*, performing two read-only live-lock snapshots across the holder lease to detect stalled fences, and defaulting source to 'status' with one-release explicit github-api rollback

Status is a fast non-mutating single snapshot that reads last-pass and matching optional detail without calling steal() or sleeping for lease, with stale records older than --max-age triggering exit 1 only when max-age is specified

Record process-surviving failure in last-pass before lock release, distinguish from SIGKILL/OOM/runner teardown via stalled live fence, reject observed leases over 480 seconds loudly, and implement ADR 0094 extending ADR 0031 live-fence and CAS-classifier prior art
